# Test Data Functions

See also [Generating Test Data](../../users_guide/generating_test_data.md).

**`Fake.address`**: A random one-line US address whose city and state belong together.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).address()   // 5666 Broad Trail, Bakersfield, CA 44960
```

**`Fake.chance`**: True with the given probability (0.0 to 1.0).

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).chance(0.5)   // false
```

**`Fake.city`**: A random US city name.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).city()   // Irvine
```

**`Fake.company`**: A random company name.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).company()   // Vargas & Ryan
```

**`Fake.country`**: A random country name.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).country()   // South Africa
```

**`Fake.domain_name`**: A random domain name.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).domain_name()   // vasquezsalt.info
```

**`Fake.email`**: A random e-mail address at a reserved example domain (example.com, .org, .net); with a name, one made from that name.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).email("Ada Lovelace")   // ada.lovelace57@example.net
```

**`Fake.first_name`**: A random English given name.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).first_name()   // Victoria
```

**`Fake.float`**: A random float from 0.0 (included) to 1.0 (excluded), or from lo to hi.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).float(0, 100)   // 56.65615751722809
```

**`Fake.fork`**: An independent generator for a named stream of the same seed, unaffected by what was drawn before.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).fork("people").first_name()   // Mason
```

**`Fake.full_name`**: A random given name and surname.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).full_name()   // Victoria Vargas
```

**`Fake.int`**: A random integer from lo to hi, both included.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).int(1, 6)   // 4
```

**`Fake.job_title`**: A random job title such as Senior Data Analyst.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).job_title()   // Principal Infrastructure Officer
```

**`Fake.last_name`**: A random English surname.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).last_name()   // Vasquez
```

**`Fake.lorem`**: Lorem ipsum text of a random length from lo to hi bytes, in paragraphs, ending with a period.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).lorem(100, 200).len()   // 157
```

**`Fake.lorem_paragraph`**: A random Lorem ipsum paragraph of 3 to 7 sentences.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).lorem_paragraph().len()   // 300
```

**`Fake.lorem_sentence`**: A random Lorem ipsum sentence of 6 to 14 words.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).lorem_sentence()   // Vel non non accumsan libero est consequat ac excepteur montes sunt.
```

**`Fake.phone`**: A random US phone number in the fictional 555-01xx range.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).phone()   // +1-648-555-0174
```

**`Fake.pick`**: A random element of a non-empty array.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).pick(["red", "green", "blue"])   // green
```

**`Fake.sample`**: The given number of distinct elements of the array, in random order.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).sample([1, 2, 3, 4], 2)   // [3, 4]
```

**`Fake.seed`**: The seed the generator (or the root of a fork) was created with; pass it to Fake(seed) to reproduce a run.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).seed()   // 1
```

**`Fake.sentence`**: A random sentence of 4 to 12 words.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).sentence()   // Salt winter linen linen shadow swift mountain glacier snow.
```

**`Fake.shuffle`**: A copy of the array in random order.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).shuffle([1, 2, 3, 4])   // [1, 2, 4, 3]
```

**`Fake.state`**: A random US state name.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).state()   // New Hampshire
```

**`Fake.state_abbr`**: A random US state postal abbreviation.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).state_abbr()   // NH
```

**`Fake.street_address`**: A random house number and street name.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).street_address()   // 5666 Broad Trail
```

**`Fake.street_name`**: A random street name.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).street_name()   // Lakeview Circle
```

**`Fake.username`**: A random user name: a lowercase given name, an initial and a number.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).username()   // victoriav971
```

**`Fake.uuid`**: A random version 4 UUID value drawn from the seed.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).uuid().as_string()   // 910a2dec-8902-4cc1-beeb-8da1658eec67
```

**`Fake.word`**: A random English word.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).word()   // onyx
```

**`Fake.zip_code`**: A random five-digit US ZIP code.

```rhai,graph=modern
Fake(1).zip_code()   // 57062
```
